note: Picture how tos for every app feature. Made by scripts/build-howto.mjs: edit there, then run it.

steps.text: Make a hunt plan. Tap Plan a hunt on Home.
steps.alt: Step 1: Home screen with the Plan a hunt button marked 1

steps.text: Home now shows Today's study at the top. Tap the orange button.
steps.alt: Step 2: Home with the Today's study card and the orange Read today's screens button marked 2

steps.text: About 10 minutes a day: a few screens plus 10 cards. Must know screens come first.
steps.alt: Step 3: A lesson screen with the Next button marked 3

steps.text: To change the pace, open the plan and tap part 5 Study.
steps.alt: Step 4: Plan page with the 5 Study part marked 4

steps.text: Tap More, then Today's cards.
steps.alt: Step 1: More list with Today's cards marked 1

steps.text: Read the card. Tap it to flip.
steps.alt: Step 2: A flashcard that says Tap to flip, marked 2

steps.text: Say how well you knew it: Knew it or Missed it.
steps.alt: Step 3: Knew it and Missed it buttons marked 3

steps.text: Cards you miss come back tomorrow. Cards you know come back later.
steps.alt: Step 4: Two cards: Missed it comes back tomorrow, Knew it comes back in 1 day, then 6 days

steps.text: On Home, tap Plan a hunt.
steps.alt: Step 1: Home with the Plan a hunt button marked 1

steps.text: Answer 8 short questions: animal, place, dates and more. Then 9 optional ones you can skip.
steps.alt: Step 2: Plan a hunt, question 1 of 8, What animal?, with Black bear marked 2

steps.text: Your plan: is it open, odds, days, checklist and study, in 5 parts.
steps.alt: Step 3: Plan page with parts 1 Legal to 5 Study and a green Open box

steps.text: Share, Print, Change or Delete it any time. Plans stay on this phone.
steps.alt: Step 4: Plan buttons Share, Print, Change and Delete, marked 4

steps.text: On Home, under Plan a hunt, tap With my brother or Solo.
steps.alt: Step 1: Home with the two Harrison deer buttons marked 1

steps.text: It fills in the animal, place and method. You pick the dates.
steps.alt: Step 2: When? question with This weekend, Next 7 days and Opening week, Next 7 days marked 2

steps.text: Answer Staying overnight? Yes or No.
steps.alt: Step 3: Staying overnight? with Yes and No buttons, No marked 3

steps.text: Read first: Your Harrison deer hunt. The rules that bite there.
steps.alt: Step 4: Plan page Read first card with the Your Harrison deer hunt button marked 4

steps.text: From 14 days before a saved plan starts, Home shows a Hunt week card.
steps.alt: Step 1: Home with a Hunt week card marked 1

steps.text: Or tap More, then Hunt week checklist.
steps.alt: Step 2: More list with Hunt week checklist marked 2

steps.text: Tick each line as you do it. Ticks stay on this phone.
steps.alt: Step 3: Hunt week list, 2 weeks out, with a tick box marked 3

steps.text: Tap More, then Hunt ready score and your weak spots.
steps.alt: Step 1: More list with Hunt ready score marked 1

steps.text: Hunt ready scores one saved plan: its dates, place and study path.
steps.alt: Step 2: Progress screen with the Hunt ready card

steps.text: Weak spots come from your quizzes, cards and trainers. Tap one to practise.
steps.alt: Step 3: Weak spots card with Today's cards, Lessons and Trainers buttons marked 3

steps.text: On Home, tap How to use this app. Or More, How to use this app.
steps.alt: Step 1: Home with the New here? card and How to use marked 1

steps.text: Tap a topic to jump to it.
steps.alt: Step 2: Guide screen with topic buttons, Hunt Map marked 2

steps.text: Each part: what it does, picture steps and a button to open it.
steps.alt: Step 3: A guide card with picture steps and an Open button marked 3

steps.text: Inside a screen, tap How to for its picture steps.
steps.alt: Step 4: Safety screen with the small How to button marked 4

steps.text: Open the Map tab.
steps.alt: Step 1: App tabs with Map marked 1

steps.text: Tap Layers, bottom left of the map.
steps.alt: Step 2: Hunt Map with the Layers button marked 2

steps.text: Tap Clean, Scouting or Hunt day to switch many layers at once.
steps.alt: Step 3: Hunt Map Layers sheet with Clean, Scouting and Hunt day, Hunt day marked 3

steps.text: Clean: base map. Scouting: spots, camps, winter range. Hunt day: no shooting areas, Crown land, MU lines.
steps.alt: Step 4: The three set buttons, Hunt day on

steps.text: On the map, tap What am I looking at?
steps.alt: Step 1: Hunt Map with the What am I looking at? button marked 1

steps.text: Read the key: every colour on screen and what it means.
steps.alt: Step 2: What am I looking at? sheet with colour swatches

steps.text: In Layers, tap the i button by a layer: what it shows, why it matters, how sure.
steps.alt: Step 3: Layers list with the i button marked 3

steps.text: Tap the magnifying glass, top right of the map.
steps.alt: Step 1: Hunt Map with the search button marked 1

steps.text: Type a town, lake, MU, camp or coordinates.
steps.alt: Step 2: Search box with Harrison Lake typed, marked 2

steps.text: Tap a result to go there.
steps.alt: Step 3: A list of results with the first one marked 3

steps.text: Works with no signal for MUs, coordinates and your saved places.
steps.alt: Step 4: Hunt Map centred on the place found

features.title: Tap card: Here on the map

steps.text: Tap anywhere on the map, or press and hold.
steps.alt: Step 1: Hunt Map with a tap point marked 1

steps.text: Read the card: MU, land, legal light now, and what is on the map here.
steps.alt: Step 2: Here on the map card with MU, Land and Legal light lines

steps.text: Tap Can I hunt here now? for a yes, no or check.
steps.alt: Step 3: The orange Can I hunt here now? button marked 3

steps.text: Or Save point, Directions, Log sighting or Mark my truck here.
steps.alt: Step 4: Card buttons Save point, Directions, Log sighting and Mark my truck here

steps.text: Tap Tools, at the bottom of the map.
steps.alt: Step 1: Hunt Map bottom bar with Tools marked 1

steps.text: Tap Can I hunt here now?
steps.alt: Step 2: Tools sheet with Can I hunt here now? marked 2

steps.text: Pick the animal and how you will shoot.
steps.alt: Step 3: Can I hunt here now? sheet with Animal and How you will shoot boxes marked 3

steps.text: Tap a point on the map. It checks the MU, season today, legal light and land.
steps.alt: Step 4: A point on the map with a YES, NO or CHECK answer

steps.text: Always read the Still check yourself lines. The map is a study aid, not the law.
steps.alt: Step 5: Still check yourself list under the answer

steps.text: Tap Tools, at the bottom of the map.
steps.alt: Step 1: Hunt Map bottom bar with Tools marked 1

steps.text: Tap Where can I hunt?
steps.alt: Step 2: Tools sheet with Where can I hunt? marked 2

steps.text: Bright green: likely open. Grey: check first.
steps.alt: Step 3: Map with bright green and grey areas

steps.text: A first look only. Before you hunt, use Can I hunt here now?
steps.alt: Step 4: Tools sheet with Can I hunt here now? marked 4

steps.text: In Layers, tap Scouting: it shows spots and camps.
steps.alt: Step 1: Layers sheet with Scouting marked 1

steps.text: Tap a spot or a camp on the map for its card.
steps.alt: Step 2: Hunt Map with a spot dot marked 2

steps.text: Spot tags: Good for 2, Good solo, Beginner friendly, and popular or quieter (an estimate).
steps.alt: Step 3: Spot card with tags

steps.text: Every spot is a candidate. Scout it first. Tap Full rundown for more.
steps.alt: Step 4: Spot card with the Full rundown button marked 4

steps.text: At the truck, tap Mark my truck, top left of the map.
steps.alt: Step 1: Hunt Map with the Mark my truck chip marked 1

steps.text: An arrow then points back to the truck, with the distance and a walk back time (Tip).
steps.alt: Step 2: Truck chip with an arrow and the distance

steps.text: Tap the chip again: Show on map, Use the compass, Move truck or Remove truck.
steps.alt: Step 3: Hunt day sheet, Back to the truck, with the buttons marked 3

steps.text: Top left: minutes of legal shooting light left where you stand.
steps.alt: Step 1: Legal light chip marked 1

steps.text: Orange under 30 minutes. Red under 10.
steps.alt: Step 2: Three legal light chips: normal, orange and red

steps.text: Tap the chip to set a turnaround: walk out minutes, then Start.
steps.alt: Step 3: Hunt day sheet, Turnaround, with Start marked 3

steps.text: A turnaround chip then counts down. It rings on any screen while the app is open.
steps.alt: Step 4: Turnaround chip with a countdown under the legal light chip

features.title: Save this hunt area for no signal

steps.text: Open your saved plan: More, or Home, My hunt plans.
steps.alt: Step 1: Home quick links with My hunt plans marked 1

steps.text: Find the Offline for no signal box. Red means not saved yet.
steps.alt: Step 2: Offline for no signal card with Not ready offline in red

steps.text: On wifi, tap Save this hunt area for no signal. Keep the app open.
steps.alt: Step 3: Save this hunt area button marked 3, with wifi

steps.text: Then tap Check again. It should say ready.
steps.alt: Step 4: Check again button marked 4 and a ready message

steps.text: Tap Layers, bottom left of the map.
steps.alt: Step 1: Hunt Map with the Layers button marked 1

steps.text: Scroll to the Terrain group. Turn on Steep ground. It is off at first.
steps.alt: Step 2: Terrain group with the Steep ground switch marked 2

steps.text: Yellow 25 to 30 degrees. Orange 30 to 35. Red over 35. An estimate.
steps.alt: Step 3: Map with yellow, orange and red slope bands

steps.text: Plan the shot around the pack out: red ground is a hard, risky carry (Tip).
steps.alt: Step 4: Map with a red slope and a pack out path to the truck

steps.text: Tap the ? button on the right of the map.
steps.alt: Step 1: Hunt Map with the help button marked 1

steps.text: Read what every map button does, top, side and bottom.
steps.alt: Step 2: Help sheet listing map buttons with icons

steps.text: Tap Show me the tour again for the 5 step tour.
steps.alt: Step 3: Help sheet with the orange Show me the tour again button marked 3

steps.text: On Home, tap Safety.
steps.alt: Step 1: Home quick links with Safety marked 1

steps.text: Tap Trip plan.
steps.alt: Step 2: Safety screen with Trip plan marked 2

steps.text: Fill in who, where and when back. It saves on this phone as you type.
steps.alt: Step 3: Trip plan form with Who, Where and Back by boxes

steps.text: Tap Send. Your phone opens Messages or Mail. You press send.
steps.alt: Step 4: Send, Copy, Text message and Email buttons, Send marked 4

steps.text: Back home? Tap Send "I am back safe". Nothing is sent without your tap.
steps.alt: Step 5: Send I am back safe button marked 5

steps.text: On Home, tap Safety.
steps.alt: Step 1: Home quick links with Safety marked 1

steps.text: Tap Turnaround alarm.
steps.alt: Step 2: Safety screen with Turnaround alarm marked 2

steps.text: Type your walk out time, or tap 30, 60, 90 or 120 min.
steps.alt: Step 3: Walk out time box and 30, 60, 90, 120 minute buttons, 60 marked 3

steps.text: Tap Start the alarm. It counts down while the app is open.
steps.alt: Step 4: Start the alarm button marked 4

steps.text: iPhone pauses web apps when locked. Tap Set a phone alarm too.
steps.alt: Step 5: Make sure it rings card with Set a phone alarm too marked 5

steps.text: On Home, tap Safety. Or the Field tab, Emergency.
steps.alt: Step 1: Home quick links with Safety marked 1

steps.text: Tap Emergency card.
steps.alt: Step 2: Safety screen with Emergency card marked 2

steps.text: 1. Call 911.
steps.alt: Step 3: Red Call 911 button marked 3

steps.text: 2. Tap Get my GPS location. Read it out. GPS works with no signal.
steps.alt: Step 4: Get my GPS location button marked 4

steps.text: 3. Tell dispatch, in the order on the card.
steps.alt: Step 5: Tell dispatch card with numbered lines

steps.text: On Home, tap Safety.
steps.alt: Step 1: Home quick links with Safety marked 1

steps.text: Tap Bears and cougars.
steps.alt: Step 2: Safety screen with Bears and cougars marked 2

steps.text: Jump to what you need: Bear, Attack, Cougar or Spray.
steps.alt: Step 3: Bear, Attack, Cougar and Spray buttons, Bear marked 3

steps.text: Never run from a bear or a cougar (75%, WildSafeBC).
steps.alt: Step 4: A rule card: never run from a bear or a cougar, 75%

steps.text: On Home, tap Safety.
steps.alt: Step 1: Home quick links with Safety marked 1

steps.text: Scroll down. Tap Conditions check.
steps.alt: Step 2: Safety screen with Conditions check marked 2

steps.text: Choose where, then tap Check now while you have signal.
steps.alt: Step 3: Check now button marked 3

steps.text: Read the results. They stay saved for when you lose signal.
steps.alt: Step 4: Results card with Last checked time

steps.text: On Home, tap Practice.
steps.alt: Step 1: Home quick links with Practice marked 1

steps.text: Pick a trainer. Four trainers, 10 rounds each.
steps.alt: Step 2: Practice screen with trainer cards, Shot placement marked 2

steps.text: Shot placement: tap where you would aim, or pass when it is not a good shot.
steps.alt: Step 3: A deer outline with a tap point and a Pass button

steps.text: Every answer is explained from the lessons.
steps.alt: Step 4: Answer card with the rule, certainty and the lesson

steps.text: On Home, tap Practice. Then Shoot or don't shoot.
steps.alt: Step 1: Practice screen with Shoot or don't shoot marked 1

steps.text: Tap Start 10 rounds. Harrison deer scenarios come first.
steps.alt: Step 2: Start 10 rounds button marked 2

steps.text: Read the situation, look at the picture, make the call.
steps.alt: Step 3: A scenario picture with answer buttons, one marked 3

steps.text: Each answer shows the rule, how sure the app is, the source and the lesson to reopen.
steps.alt: Step 4: Answer with the rule, a certainty badge and the lesson

steps.text: Tap the Field tab. Then Shot taken: guide me.
steps.alt: Step 1: Field Mode with Shot taken: guide me marked 1

steps.text: Tap I just shot. Start. One step at a time, 10 steps.
steps.alt: Step 2: After the shot with I just shot. Start marked 2 and the step list

steps.text: Step 1: tap Save my spot. Your phone finds you with GPS, no signal needed.
steps.alt: Step 3: Step 1 of 10, Mark the spot, with Save my spot marked 3

steps.text: Tap Done for the next step. Back goes one step back.
steps.alt: Step 4: Back and Done buttons, Done marked 4

steps.text: Open a lesson or Today's cards.
steps.alt: Step 1: Learn tab marked 1

steps.text: Tap Read aloud, above the screen. It reads the title, then the text.
steps.alt: Step 2: Lesson screen with the Read aloud button marked 2

steps.text: Tap 1× to change the speed. The slider button: voice and keep going.
steps.alt: Step 3: Speed and settings buttons marked 3

steps.text: It uses the phone's own voice, so it works offline with the voices on the phone.
steps.alt: Step 4: Phone speaker with no signal

steps.text: Tap the Field tab.
steps.alt: Step 1: App tabs with Field marked 1

steps.text: Big buttons for the bush: Legal to shoot?, Legal light, Tag it, After the shot.
steps.alt: Step 2: Field Mode buttons, Legal to shoot? marked 2

steps.text: Legal to shoot?: one check at a time. Tap YES or NO.
steps.alt: Step 3: Legal to shoot? check 1 of 9 with YES and NO, YES marked 3

steps.text: Field Mode works with no signal.
steps.alt: Step 4: Field Mode with a no signal sign

steps.text: Tap More, then Hunt journal.
steps.alt: Step 1: More list with Hunt journal marked 1

steps.text: Tap New entry. Log every trip, even blank ones.
steps.alt: Step 2: Hunt journal with New entry marked 2

steps.text: Fill in date, place, weather and what you saw. Tap Save.
steps.alt: Step 3: Journal form with Save marked 3

steps.text: Tap Export CSV for a spreadsheet file.
steps.alt: Step 4: Export CSV button marked 4

steps.text: Everything lives on this phone only. Tap More.
steps.alt: Step 1: App tabs with More marked 1

steps.text: Scroll to Backup. Tap Export backup. It saves one file.
steps.alt: Step 2: Backup card with Export backup marked 2

steps.text: Keep the file in your files or email. Export one before the hunt.
steps.alt: Step 3: A backup file going to Files or email

steps.text: New phone or cleared app? Tap Import and pick the file. Map items come back too.
steps.alt: Step 4: Import button marked 4

steps.text: iPhone: open the app in Safari (not Chrome).
steps.alt: Step 1: Safari address bar at the bottom of the phone

steps.text: Tap the Share button: a square with an arrow up.
steps.alt: Step 2: Safari Share button marked 2

steps.text: Scroll down. Tap Add to Home Screen, then Add.
steps.alt: Step 3: Share sheet with Add to Home Screen marked 3

steps.text: Open it once from the home screen with signal. Then it works offline.
steps.alt: Step 4: Phone home screen with the Hunt Mentor icon marked 4

steps.text: Android: open it in Chrome. Tap the three dots, then Install app or Add to Home screen.
steps.alt: Step 5: Chrome three dots menu marked 5
